objective: Research the 2025-2026 Roblox market (top and fastest-growing games, mechanics, discovery, child-safe monetisation, saturation) and propose five scored concepts for game 6 with a recommendation.
inputs: SHANNON's request in the project thread, 2026-11-06
acceptance_criteria: docs/game-design/game6-market-research.md cites every fact with a link and a source grade, and labels low-quality pages
The research doc has a top-15 table (genre, launch, peak CCU, team, core hook), growth patterns, discovery and monetisation notes, a saturation map and a studio-fit section

docs/game-design/game6-concepts.md has five concepts, each with pitch, 30-second loop, 10-minute and 10-day hooks, social hook, shareable moment, why now, studio fit, risks and a score on the game 3/4 rubric
Every concept passes the child-safety gate: no stealing, paid randomness, trading or free text
Facts, assumptions and hypotheses are labelled separately (CLAUDE.md rule 10)
verification: SHANNON picks a concept or returns the docs with changes; CI green on the docs PR
evidence: Web research 2026-11-06: Roblox Creator Docs, DevForum, newsroom, Q2 and Q3 2026 earnings, GameAnalytics, RoWatcher; links in the research doc
notes: Docs only: no game code, no publish, no spending. Recommendation: concept A (Lantern Express), fallback C. Checkpoint items in game6-concepts.md section 5.
